fade-in.name: Fade in
fade-in.description: A quiet entrance. From invisible to there.
fade-in.explanation: An element gradually becomes visible, moving from transparent to fully opaque. Its position stays still, letting the content speak for itself.
fade-in.usage: Introduce images, supporting content, or a gentle change of state without pulling attention away from the page.
fade-in.synonyms: appear opacity dissolve surgir Aparición gradual aparecer opacidad disolver desvanecer Fade in appear opacity dissolve surgir
fade-in.prompt: Reveal the element with a fade-in: animate its opacity from 0 to 1 over 400 ms using an ease-out curve. Keep its position and size unchanged.

slide-in.name: Slide in
slide-in.description: A little movement in the right direction.
slide-in.explanation: An element travels a short distance into its final position while fading into view. The direction gives the entrance a sense of origin.
slide-in.usage: Introduce a panel, a new section, or content entering from the edge of a layout.
slide-in.synonyms: move translate entrance sliding deslizar Entrada deslizante mover trasladar entrada deslizar deslizamiento Slide in move translate entrance sliding deslizar
slide-in.prompt: Reveal the element with a slide-in from below: animate translateY from 64 px to 0 and opacity from 0 to 1 over 700 ms with ease-out. Keep the surrounding layout fixed.

pop-in.name: Pop in
pop-in.description: Small start. A slightly bouncy arrival.
pop-in.explanation: An element scales past its resting size, then settles back. The small overshoot makes the entrance feel playful and physical.
pop-in.usage: Draw attention to a badge, a new item, or an occasional moment of positive feedback.
pop-in.synonyms: pop scale appear jump salto Entrada con rebote escala aparecer salto rebotar Pop in pop scale appear jump salto
pop-in.prompt: Make the element pop in over 700 ms: begin at 70% scale and zero opacity, grow to 112%, and settle at 100%. Keep its center fixed and use a soft overshoot.

scale-up.name: Scale up
scale-up.description: Grow into place, without the bounce.
scale-up.explanation: An element grows smoothly from a smaller size to its final dimensions. Unlike pop in, it settles without overshooting.
scale-up.usage: Bring an image, dialog, or focal element into view with a simple sense of depth.
scale-up.synonyms: grow enlarge zoom entrance crescer Aumento de escala crecer ampliar zoom entrada Scale up grow enlarge zoom entrance crescer
scale-up.prompt: Reveal the element by scaling it from 55% to 100% while fading opacity from 0 to 1 over 700 ms using ease-out. Do not overshoot or change layout dimensions.

blur-in.name: Blur in
blur-in.description: From out of focus to perfectly clear.
blur-in.explanation: A soft, blurred element becomes sharp and fully visible. The reveal changes focus rather than moving across the screen.
blur-in.usage: Give a headline, photograph, or editorial reveal a cinematic entrance. Use sparingly because blur requires painting.
blur-in.synonyms: focus sharp defocus blur reveal borrado Entrada desde desenfoque enfoque nitidez desenfoque borroso revelar Blur in focus sharp defocus blur reveal borrado
blur-in.prompt: Reveal the element over 900 ms by animating filter blur from 18 px to 0 and opacity from 0 to 1 with ease-out. Keep position and size fixed.

stagger.name: Stagger
stagger.explanation: A group shares the same entrance, but each item begins a little after the last. The sequence turns separate elements into a readable rhythm.
stagger.usage: Introduce cards, list items, or a small group of related elements in a deliberate order.
stagger.synonyms: cascade sequence delay list cascata Entrada escalonada cascada secuencia retraso lista escalonado Stagger cascade sequence delay list cascata
stagger.prompt: Reveal four items with a stagger: fade each from 0 to 1 and translateY from 30 px to 0 over 500 ms using ease-out. Start each item 130 ms after the previous one.

overshoot.name: Overshoot
overshoot.description: Go a little too far. Then settle in.
overshoot.explanation: An element travels beyond its destination and gently returns. That extra movement suggests momentum rather than an abrupt stop.
overshoot.usage: Give a meaningful entrance or repositioning a small sense of weight and personality.
overshoot.synonyms: past return momentum settle passa Sobrepaso pasar retorno inercia estabilizar sobrepasar Overshoot past return momentum settle passa
overshoot.prompt: Move the element horizontally from -90 px to 0 over 1000 ms. Pass the destination by 22 px, then settle at 0 with a single soft overshoot.

bounce.name: Bounce
bounce.description: A landing with a little life in it.
bounce.explanation: An element falls toward a surface and rebounds with progressively smaller hops, as if gravity is bringing it to rest.
bounce.usage: Illustrate a landing or add occasional playful feedback to a successful action.
bounce.synonyms: hop gravity ball rebound quicar Rebote salto gravedad pelota rebotar Bounce hop gravity ball rebound quicar
bounce.prompt: Animate a square dropping toward a baseline over 1300 ms. Bounce upward three times with decreasing heights, then rest on the baseline. Keep horizontal position fixed.

spring.name: Spring
spring.explanation: A displaced element oscillates around its resting position, losing energy with each swing. It resembles an object suspended on a spring.
spring.usage: Demonstrate physical settling and movement that should feel weighted.
spring.synonyms: physics oscillation damping mola Resorte fisica física oscilación amortiguación muelle Spring physics oscillation damping mola
spring.prompt: Animate a suspended square with a damped spring over 1500 ms. Pull it down 60 px, then oscillate around its resting position with decreasing amplitude until it comes to rest.

ease-in-out.name: Ease in-out
ease-in-out.description: Start slow. Find your pace. Slow down.
ease-in-out.explanation: Movement accelerates gradually and decelerates before stopping. A linear comparison makes the difference in speed easy to see.
ease-in-out.usage: Move an element between two visible positions when both departure and arrival should feel deliberate.
ease-in-out.synonyms: accelerate decelerate smooth easing linear Aceleración y frenado acelerar desacelerar suave curva lineal Ease in-out accelerate decelerate smooth easing linear
ease-in-out.prompt: Move two markers horizontally across equal tracks over 1400 ms. Use linear easing on the first and ease-in-out on the second so their acceleration and deceleration can be compared.

elastic.name: Elastic
elastic.explanation: An element snaps toward its destination and wobbles around it with elastic rebounds. It feels more pronounced and stretchy than a single overshoot.
elastic.usage: Explain elastic motion or add a rare expressive accent to a playful experience.
elastic.synonyms: rubber band stretch snap elastico Elástico banda goma estirar elástico elastico Elastic rubber band stretch snap elastico
elastic.prompt: Move the square from -90 px to 0 over 1600 ms: overshoot by 38 px, rebound by 24 px, then oscillate with decreasing amplitude until resting at 0.

pulse.name: Pulse
pulse.description: A small beat that says: look here.
pulse.explanation: An element expands and returns to its original size. A fading outer ring reinforces the beat without changing the surrounding layout.
pulse.usage: Briefly point out a location, available action, or status change. Avoid endless attention-seeking loops.
pulse.synonyms: beat attention ring location pulsar Pulso latido atención anillo ubicación pulsar Pulse beat attention ring location pulsar
pulse.prompt: Create one pulse over 1100 ms: scale the central marker from 1 to 1.18 and back to 1. Expand an outer ring from 1 to 2.2 while fading it out. Do not loop automatically.

typewriter.name: Typewriter
typewriter.description: A thought, one character at a time.
typewriter.explanation: Text is revealed in discrete character-sized steps, accompanied by a cursor. The letters appear in reading order rather than fading together.
typewriter.usage: Present a short command, an occasional narrative line, or a terminal-inspired message.
typewriter.synonyms: typing character cursor machine maquina Máquina de escribir escribir carácter cursor maquina máquina Typewriter typing character cursor machine maquina
typewriter.prompt: Reveal “Make it move.” one character at a time over 1500 ms using 13 discrete steps. Keep a caret at the end of the visible text and keep the line position fixed.

count-up.name: Count up
count-up.description: Numbers with a sense of progress.
count-up.explanation: A numeric value increases from zero to a target. The unit stays still so the viewer can follow the changing value.
count-up.usage: Introduce a meaningful statistic or visualize progress toward a fixed number.
count-up.synonyms: counter counting number statistic anos Conteo ascendente contador contar número estadística Count up counter counting number statistic anos
count-up.prompt: Animate a numeric counter from 0 to 100 over 1600 ms with ease-out. Keep the percent sign stationary and use tabular numerals to prevent layout shift.

word-reveal.name: Word reveal
word-reveal.description: Give every word its own moment.
word-reveal.explanation: A sentence appears word by word, combining a small vertical movement with a fade. The order follows the natural reading direction.
word-reveal.usage: Reveal a short headline or emphasize the pacing of a concise editorial sentence.
word-reveal.synonyms: split text words sequential palavra Aparición por palabras texto palabras secuencia revelar Word reveal split text words sequential palavra
word-reveal.prompt: Reveal “Good things take motion.” word by word. Animate each word from translateY(18 px) and opacity 0 to its resting position and opacity 1 over 450 ms, with 230 ms between word starts.

ticker.name: Ticker
ticker.explanation: A continuous strip of text travels horizontally through a clipped window. Linear speed keeps movement steady and readable.
ticker.usage: Show a short announcement or an editorial strip with optional playback.
ticker.synonyms: marquee scrolling sliding text rolling letreiro Texto deslizante marquesina desplazar deslizar texto continuo Ticker marquee scrolling sliding text rolling letreiro
ticker.prompt: Move a horizontal strip reading “IDEAS IN MOTION — MAKE SOMETHING MOVE —” from right to left at a constant speed over 2600 ms, clipped to its container. Play one pass and provide pause controls.

highlight.name: Highlight
highlight.description: A moving underline for your point.
highlight.explanation: A colored highlight sweeps behind a phrase, drawing attention to words that remain still and readable.
highlight.usage: Emphasize a key phrase or important takeaway without moving the text.
highlight.synonyms: marker emphasis underline grifar Resaltado marcador énfasis subrayar resaltar Highlight marker emphasis underline grifar
highlight.prompt: Sweep a lime highlight from left to right behind “worth a second look” over 1000 ms using ease-in-out. Keep the text fixed, fully visible, and readable throughout.

text-swap.name: Text swap
text-swap.explanation: A word slides out of a clipped text window as another slides in. The surrounding sentence stays still.
text-swap.usage: Show alternatives within one short headline or switch between product qualities.
text-swap.synonyms: rotating word change replace trocar Cambio de texto rotar palabra cambiar reemplazar Text swap rotating word change replace trocar
text-swap.prompt: Under the fixed label “MAKE IT”, slide “simple.” upward out of a clipped window while “moving.” enters from below over 1000 ms using ease-in-out. Preserve the text container height.

draw-on.name: Draw on
draw-on.description: A line finding its way into being.
draw-on.explanation: An outline is progressively drawn along a path. Animating the visible stroke makes the shape look as though a pen is tracing it.
draw-on.usage: Reveal an illustration, route, icon, or simple hand-drawn accent.
draw-on.synonyms: svg stroke path trace drawing traco Trazado progresivo svg trazo trayectoria dibujar dibujo Draw on svg stroke path trace drawing traco
draw-on.prompt: Draw an SVG path from start to finish over 1600 ms with ease-in-out by animating stroke-dashoffset from the total path length to 0. Use a lime stroke and no fill.

mask-reveal.name: Mask reveal
mask-reveal.description: Uncover what was there all along.
mask-reveal.explanation: A clipping mask expands to uncover an element. The content stays still while its visible area grows.
mask-reveal.usage: Reveal an image, geometric composition, or headline with a radial opening.
mask-reveal.synonyms: clip clipping circle uncover mascara Revelado con máscara recorte círculo descubrir máscara mascara Mask reveal clip clipping circle uncover mascara
mask-reveal.prompt: Reveal the composition with an expanding circular clip-path over 1100 ms using ease-out. Expand the circle from 0% to 75% at the center without scaling the underlying content.

wipe.name: Wipe
wipe.description: One scene makes way for another.
wipe.explanation: A new surface sweeps across the old one, replacing it along a clean moving edge.
wipe.usage: Demonstrate a before-and-after or switch between two distinct scenes.
wipe.synonyms: curtain transition before after cortina Barrido cortina transición antes después Wipe curtain transition before after cortina
wipe.prompt: Transition from a dark panel labeled “Before” to a lime panel labeled “After” using a left-to-right wipe over 1200 ms with ease-in-out. Keep both labels stationary in their panels.

punch-zoom.name: Punch zoom
punch-zoom.description: A closer look. An instant of impact.
punch-zoom.explanation: The entire composition quickly zooms inward and settles back. This brief camera-like move makes the focal content feel more immediate.
punch-zoom.usage: Add occasional impact to a reveal, key number, or storytelling beat.
punch-zoom.synonyms: camera impact zoom punch snap Zoom de impacto cámara impacto zoom acercar Punch zoom camera impact zoom punch snap
punch-zoom.prompt: Create a punch zoom on a framed “8 million ideas” composition over 800 ms: quickly scale from 1 to 1.3, then settle at 1. Keep the transform origin centered and clip the scene to its viewport.

bar-grow.name: Bar grow
bar-grow.description: From a starting point to something more.
bar-grow.explanation: A bar extends from its anchored edge toward its final length. Scaling avoids moving the surrounding layout.
bar-grow.usage: Introduce a progress indicator or show the relative size of a simple value.
bar-grow.synonyms: progress fill chart loading barra Crecimiento de barra progreso relleno gráfico carga barra Bar grow progress fill chart loading barra
bar-grow.prompt: Grow a horizontal lime bar from scaleX(0) to scaleX(1) over 1200 ms using ease-out with transform-origin at the left edge. Keep its container and label fixed.

morph.name: Morph
morph.explanation: A square smoothly rounds into a circle while keeping the same center and visual continuity.
morph.usage: Explain a transformation or connect related visual states through a shared shape.
morph.synonyms: shape transformation circle square border radius forma Transformación de forma forma transformación círculo cuadrado radio borde Morph shape transformation circle square border radius forma
morph.prompt: Morph a lime square into a circle over 1400 ms using ease-in-out by animating border-radius from 8% to 50% with a subtle quarter-turn rotation. Preserve its center and size.
